architecture_override.authority: ADR-0012 governs Logical Tunnel multipath/lifecycle; ADR-0011 governs per-lane same-association bootstrap/no-HOL. ADR-0013/0014/0015 are withdrawn where they globalize single-flow.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE / transport epoch. One Logical Tunnel owns stable identity/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain with 1..4 logical lanes. Normal desired=1; Game/weak desired=2..4.
architecture_override.game_one_lane: wbd-game-lane-client remains required as the race/dedup aggregation point even when Lanes=1. Do not bypass it.
architecture_override.replacement: Generation-fenced make-before-break A -> A+B -> B; candidate failure preserves healthy A. Physical slots are bounded to 1..5, with the spare used only for replacement overlap, never as a fifth logical lane.
architecture_override.server_path: Linux final path is one shared WBD TUN + root routing + one WBD-owned host NAT.
architecture_override.lease_source_boundary: Raw IPv4 ingress requires source == server-issued Logical Tunnel lease. Do not weaken anti-spoof for APIPA/arbitrary source addresses.
architecture_override.ipv6: Windows product IPv6 remains fail-closed until qualified; non-IPv4 must not enter the IPv4 Game/raw-IP backend.
architecture_override.nat_observability: SourceIP/default-route changes are not authoritative direct public NAT mapping reflection.
